justification: `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFile.java` is 671 lines and contains ~28 methods, mixing distinct responsibilities: block-array/storage management (`copyBlocksTo`, `transferBlocksTo`, `truncateBlocks`, `addBlock`), lifecycle/delete tracking (`opened`, `closed`, `deleted`), size/accounting, and full read/write/transfer I/O for arrays, `ByteBuffer`, and channels. `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/HeapDisk.java` also treats it as a disk/block-cache helper, and `jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/RegularFileTest.java` covers many separate behaviors. The breadth and concentration of these concerns indicate insufficient modularization.
